mechanism: Chloroquine inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism of verapamil, increasing verapamil plasma concentrations and risk of cardiotoxicity; both drugs also have independent cardiac effects including QT prolongation.
action: Monitor cardiac function closely with ECG surveillance; consider dose reduction of verapamil; monitor for signs of verapamil toxicity (hypotension, bradycardia, AV block); consider alternative antimalarial if possible.
